intro: Lesson 61: Area of a triangle: counting squares. To understand how to estimate and find the area of a triangle by counting squares

questions.q: Count triangle A on the sheet.
questions.model: Teacher counts whole squares, then pairs the halves.

questions.q: Find the area of triangles D, E, F by counting.
questions.a: D 15 cm²; E 9 cm²; F about 12 cm²
questions.model: Teacher counts D with the class.

questions.q: Draw a rectangle around each triangle. Is each triangle half? Check.
questions.a: D and E: yes (30 and 18); F: about half

questions.q: Draw 2 different triangles with area 6 cm².
questions.a: For example base 4 height 3, base 6 height 2

questions.q: A right-angled triangle is... of its rectangle. A) half B) a quarter C) double
Big question: how do we count part squares fairly?
questions.a: Pair halves, count more than half as 1 and less than half as 0
